name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 24, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of the My Encinitas App by Information Systems Staff
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the March 10, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-03-24 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Fadhil
Approve the Warrants.
2021-03-24 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
The Preparation and Filing of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District Annual Engineer’s Report. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-20 entitled, “Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council Directing the Preparation and Filing of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District Annual Engineer’s Report for the Purposes of Levying and Collecting Assessments for Fiscal Year 2021--22” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-03-24 Item 08C Preparation and Filing of the ELLD Annual Engineer's Report
8D.
Appointment of Council Member Joy Lyndes to Regional Boards and Committees. Contact Person: Executive Assistant Clisby
1) Council to approve Council Member Joy Lyndes as the alternate representative for the CSA-17 Advisory Committee; 2) Council to approve Council Member Joy Lyndes as the alternate representative for the North County Dispatch Joint Powers Authority Board of Directors; 3) Council to approve Council Member Joy Lyndes as the alternate representative for the California League of Cities Region 10 Executive Committee and San Diego Division’s Legislative Committee; 4) Council to approve Council Member Joy Lyndes as representative for the City Attorney Recruitment Subcommittee; and 5) Council to approve Council Member Joy Lyndes as representative for the Cultural Tourism Committee.
2021-03-24 Item 08D Appointment of Council Member Joy Lyndes to Regional Boards and Committees
8E.
Public Hearing to consider funding requests for the FY 2021-22 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Authorize funding for activities delineated in Attachment 1 and in the Analysis Section of the Agenda Report, for incorporation into the draft FY 2021-22 Annual Action Plan, to be made available for a public review and comment period; and 2) Hold a Second Public Hearing on April 28, 2021 to Consider and Approve the FY 2021-22 Annual Action Plan.
2021-03-24 Item 08E CDBG FY 2021-22 Report
8F.
Citywide Landscape Maintenance Services Agreement Amendment No. 6. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 6 with Excel Landscape for Citywide Landscape Maintenance Services, in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in consultation with the City Attorney, adding additional sites and extra work, for a total not to exceed $10,702,235 for the six-year term.
2021-03-24 Item 08F Citywide Landscape Maintenance Services Agreement Amendment No. 6
8G.
Fiscal Year 2020-21 Mid-Year Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
1) Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Mid-Year Budget Status Report; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-23 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget.” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report)
2021-03-24 Item 08G Mid Year Budget Report and Proposed Budget Amendments
8H.
Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the General Plan. Contact Person: Planner IV Zornes
Approve the General Plan Annual Progress Report, including implementation thereof.
2021-03-24 Item 08H Annual Progress Report on the General Plan
8I.
Construction contract award for the FY2020-21 Annual Pavement Rehabilitation, Overlay and Slurry Project (CS21A). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
1) Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract in substantial form as shown in Attachment 1 of the agenda report and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Eagle Paving Company in the amount of $2,161,463 plus 15 percent contingency ($324,220) for a total construction project not-to-exceed amount of $2,485,683 to construct the FY2020-21 Annual Pavement Rehabilitation, Overlay and Slurry Project (CS21A); and 2) Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute Contract Amendment No. 1 in substantial form as contained in Attachment 2 of the agenda report, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Kleinfelder, Inc., in the amount of $297,015 plus 10 percent contingency ($29,702) for a total project not-to-exceed amount of $326,717 for construction support on the Annual Pavement Rehabilitation, Overlay and Slurry Project (CS21A).
2021-03-24 Item 08I Construction Contract Annual Pavement Rehab
8J.
An amendment to the existing Civic Solutions, Inc. contract agreement of $70,000 for additional contractual support for the remainder of Fiscal Year 2020-21. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Noel
Authorize the City Manager to amend the current contract agreement with Civic Solutions, Inc. in substantial form as attached, in consultation with the City Attorney, to include a total of $70,000 for contractual support for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $666,000.
2021-03-24 Item 08J Civic Solutions Contract Amendment
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
To amend the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Adopted Budget to allocate $315,000 from the City’s General Fund for the development of the El Camino Real Corridor Specific Plan, in addition to the $300,000 allocated from the LEAP grant at the November 18, 2020 City Council meeting, for a project total budget amount of $615,000. Contact Person: Planner IV Zornes
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-19 “A Resolution of The City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) authorizing budget transfer in the amount of $315,000 to the El Camino Real Corridor Specific Plan, Project No. WC21B for a project total budget amount of $615,000; 2) Readvertise the Request for Proposals for the El Camino Real Specific Plan; and 3) Approval to increase the agreement with JPW Communications by $25,000 for a total not to exceed $294,545.
2021-03-24 Item 10A ECRC Specific Plan Budget Request
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT MEETING WILL BE A SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING HELD ON APRIL 07, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
